profile.bio: Founder & CEO @ Ledgermoor. Month-end close automation for accounting firms. Ex-Big4, recovering auditor.

recentPosts.text: Founder-led sales got us to $1.2M ARR. It will not get us to $5M. Hiring our first SDR this quarter. If you've built outbound for a vertical SaaS, I'd love to hear what you'd do differently.
Signed our 40th accounting firm this month. Every single one came from a referral or a conference. Great problem to have, until it isn't.
Most firms lose 3 days of every month-end to reconciliations nobody owns. Assign an owner before you buy software.
